paragraphs: All digital product purchases, including Premium Accounts and Digital Subscriptions, are final and non-refundable.
Refunds will only be provided if we can no longer continue the purchased service and are unable to fix the issue or provide a replacement.

bullets: If a product stops working within its warranty period, we will help fix the issue or provide a replacement.
Refunds are only available when both service restoration and replacement are no longer possible.
Warranty is void if customers change account information or security settings without permission or misuse the product.

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Conditions
paragraphs: Refunds will not be provided for:
bullets: Change of mind or accidental purchases.
Account issues caused by customer misuse.
Temporary service interruptions or fixable issues.
Products that can be repaired or replaced.

sections.title: 4. Support & Refund Requests
paragraphs: If you experience any issues, please contact our support team with your order details and relevant evidence.
Our team will verify the issue and attempt to fix or replace the product first. Refunds will only be considered if no solution or replacement is available.

paragraphs: If there is any error, we will do our best to resolve it. However, please keep in mind that we are only responsible for account-related issues and are not liable for any problems outside of account issues.

en.title: Privacy Policy
en.intro: This policy covers our catalog, orders on pstorebynamso.com, and support through Telegram or Messenger.

sections.title: 1. Information we use
paragraphs: We use your order details, contact information, and payment screenshot to check payment, deliver your purchase, and provide support. Depending on the product, we may also need your email, username, profile name, or phone number. Any account credentials you submit become part of your order information.

sections.title: 2. Where your information goes
paragraphs: Orders submitted on pstorebynamso.com go to our team on Telegram, including screenshots and any submitted passwords. Contact and order summaries can also be saved in our order system, without those screenshots or passwords. Order records and messages can remain after delivery.
Relevant details may be used with product providers to arrange your purchase. Telegram, Messenger, and other providers handle information under their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 3. Browser storage and hosting
paragraphs: This catalog remembers your language and theme in local storage. The pstorebynamso.com storefront also remembers appearance and vibration choices and uses a temporary tab-session flag to avoid duplicate visit counts. That flag is not a customer identifier and is not sent with tracking events. You can clear site data in your browser to reset these settings.

Our custom counter does not create tracking cookies. Hosting and other services may use their own cookies. Cloudflare serves and protects pstorebynamso.com; network services process IP addresses when handling requests, although our custom statistics tables do not store them.

sections.title: 4. Questions or deletion requests
paragraphs: Message our support team with your order reference to ask about your information, correct it, or request deletion. We may need to verify the request.

en.title: Terms & Conditions
en.intro: These terms apply to VPN purchases from Premium Store. For other digital products, see the product details and our Refund & Replacement Policy.

sections.title: 1. What our service covers
paragraphs: We provide the premium VPN account or subscription you purchase. Our support covers account access and the premium subscription during the stated warranty period.
We work to resolve account problems so you can continue using your purchase. VPN connectivity also depends on your network, location, and the VPN provider.

sections.title: 2. VPN availability and restrictions
paragraphs: VPN access may be limited or blocked by government restrictions or internet providers. We cannot guarantee that a VPN will connect on every network or in every region.
A connection problem caused by these restrictions does not necessarily mean that your premium account has stopped working.

sections.title: 3. Repairs, replacements, and refunds
paragraphs: If your account stops working within its warranty period, contact us so we can help fix it or provide a replacement. Refunds are considered only when we can no longer provide the purchased service and neither a fix nor a replacement is possible.
Restrictions or bans imposed by government authorities are outside our account warranty and are not grounds for a refund. See our Refund & Replacement Policy for the full conditions.

sections.title: 4. Subscription expiry and renewal
paragraphs: Keep track of your subscription end date and set your own renewal reminder. Contact us before it expires if you want to continue the service.

sections.title: 5. Getting help
paragraphs: Send your product name, plan, order details, and a description or screenshot of the problem to our support team. We will help identify and resolve account-related issues.

Our responsibility covers account-related problems. We are not responsible for issues outside the account, including network restrictions or connection problems caused by your device or internet provider.

sections.title: 6. Before you buy
paragraphs: By purchasing a VPN service from Premium Store, you agree to these terms. If anything is unclear, please ask us before placing your order.
